# Martin Galway's C64 music

Music by Martin Galway from his Commodore 64 games (Wizball, Arkanoid, Game
Over, Green Beret and Rambo, 1985 to 1987), as RetCon songs. The tests open,
write and read back every one of them.

Copyright Martin Galway, licensed under the GNU General Public License,
version 3 (`LICENSE`). The music was written for Ocean Software; Galway later
acquired the rights and published the sources under GPL-3.0 at
<https://github.com/MartinGalway/C64_music>. He asks to be credited as the
original author of this work. Each song names its author and licence in its
own `AUTH` and `LICN` chunks.
